_comment: Run protocol values from Chapter 5 (evaluation.tex). 'decided': false marks values the chapter still lists as TODO/DECIDE; the runner and the metrics script use them as given here and copy them into every manifest.

prompts.corridor: Use the naoqi MCP server. You control a robot at the start of a corridor. Follow the corridor to its end, which is marked by a green panel, and stop in front of the panel. When the robot is there, call rest.
prompts.corridor_complex: Use the naoqi MCP server. You control a robot at the start of a corridor with several corners. Follow the corridor to its end, which is marked by a red wall, and stop in front of the wall. When the robot is there, call rest.

caps._source: Table 5.3 (tab:end_conditions): 3 x the task's longest successful pilot run and 3 x the most tool calls in a successful pilot run. Corridor from its pilot (2026-10-15: 548.3 s, 36 calls); Complex corridor still the start value until its pilot

invalid_if._source: Section 5.1.3 (Invalid runs): both DECIDE. Proposed: a provider error that remains after the harness's retries makes the run invalid (alternative: a failure, as part of the agent's reliability), and reaching a subscription or account usage limit counts as a provider error. pilot/metrics.py records the two as separate reasons either way.

min_real_time_factor._source: Section 5.1.1 (Simulated tasks): proposed 0.9; below it the run is invalid and repeated
